card.name: Inside all-caps warning headings
card.fires_on: Word endings or pieces inside ALL-CAPS boxed-warning text, such as MYASTHEN-IA, NEON-ATAL, OPIO-ID, and the word B (BONE, BAG, -BASED) in capitals.

modes.label: Ends of long capitalised terms
modes.description: The last piece of a long capitalised medical term in a warning heading, just before the next heading word.

modes.label: Capital B starting a word
modes.description: A word or piece beginning with B in capitalised warning text, such as BONE, BAG or -BASED.
modes.example: IF ANY EVIDENCE OF<< B>>ONE MARROW DEPRESSION OCCURS

card.writes: It pushes toward outputs starting with the letter B, though the suppressed tokens show no clear theme.
card.plain: It fires inside capitalised warning headings, on the end of long terms like myasthenia or on words starting with B.
